mentions.name: Tomb of His Holiness Mirza Janjanan Mazhar
mentions.passage:
Q) The tomb of His Holiness Mirza Janjanan Mazhar, the martyr*
may his tomb be purified ; dated 10th Muharram of the year 1195
(6th January 1781).

mentions.name: Tomb of His Holiness Shah Abdullah known as Shah Ghulam Ali
mentions.passage:
(2) The tomb of His Holiness Shah Abdullah known as Shah Ghulam
Ali, may his tomb be purified ; dated 22nd Safar of the year 1240
(16th October 1824).

mentions.name: Tomb of His Holiness Shah Abu Said Ahmadi
mentions.passage:
(3) The tomb of His Holiness Shah Abu Said Ahmadi, may his tomb be
purified ; dated the 1st Shawwal of the year 1250 (31st January
1835).

mentions.name: Grave of Sayyid Daud
